versions.changelog: Aegis4All 4.0.3 — fixed checkpoint #5 - logging now validated via openclaw doctor schema check instead of invalid tools.logging/session.logging keys; repair loop re-runs doctor after any config edit and never adds undocumented keys; reworded guide text that tripped defensive scanner patterns; added disambiguation guard for broad trigger phrases.

Aegis4All v4.0.2 changelog

Unified guide ratings (Guide 2/3/6), fixed report template conflicts, added read-only scope guarantee, credential-privacy rules, language mirroring, and valid quoted YAML front matter.

**Aegis4All v4.0.1 Changelog**

Expanded the audit layer from 12 to 20 checkpoints, adding DM pairing policy, group allowlists, node pairing, browser control, control-plane tool lockdown, network exposure, dangerous flags, and CVE version checks.
Integrated the official openclaw security audit command: overlapping checkpoints now read authoritative results first, with paper-defined detection rules as fallback.
Published the scoring formula: Critical / High / Warn weighted 7 / 4 / 3, warnings deducted at half weight, Score = 100 − deductions.
Redesigned the report into a single-message 4-column table (Checkpoint / Status / Detail) driven by deterministic per-checkpoint decision rules.
Added the Fix Follow-up repair loop: natural-language fix offer, explicit user confirmation before any change, then re-run safe check and report the score delta.
Added a 20-row Defense Mapping with fix safety ratings (EXECUTABLE / CONDITIONAL / ADVISORY / REFUSED) and four safety rules for automatic fixes — never restart the Gateway, never self-lock out, fix all applies only to EXECUTABLE and CONDITIONAL items.
Added Guide 6 (Lock down DM and group access) plus a compact Guide Index and Full Guide Reference.

Aegis4All 1.0.0 — initial release for OpenClaw security hardening.

- Adds "safe check"/"security check" trigger for comprehensive, read-only config audits with scored reports and prioritized recommendations.
- Enables "inject rules" trigger to append 7 security behavior rules into workspace files, using a confirmation protocol.
- Provides "security guide"/"show guide" triggers for high-risk operation guides, including step-by-step instructions and refusal protocol for unsafe actions.
- Implements multilayer audit strategies (privilege, port binding, credential checks, key scanning, skill vetting, etc.) following Zheng Tan & Lin 2026.
- No auto-remediation; actions requiring user intervention are clearly marked as INFO with guide references and agent display support.
- Integrates self-exclusion and update/removal options for injected rules, ensuring safe incremental adoption.
